verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Apify positions itself as an AI/agent-friendly platform (MCP server, LLM integration, anti-blocking proxies) but never documents a specific clean-text/markdown extraction output for LLMs — no mention of features like a 'Website Content Crawler' or HTML-to-text conversion pipeline. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a clean-text/markdown output actor, examples of LLM-ready formatted output, and independent confirmation that scraped content is de-noised for LLM consumption.
